description: Resolve conflicting next-step proposals from two or more tenant agents before execution. Uses the existing Marrow runtime gate and returns a durable arbitration receipt with the selected, synthesized, review-required, or blocked action and exactly why it changed.

agentId.description: Requesting agent id. Defaults to the canonical fleet-bound agent identity.

objective.description: The shared owner or workflow objective.

ownerIntent.description: Optional bounded owner intent used for deterministic alignment.

proof.description: Optional proof already available to the runtime gate.

agent_id.description: Existing agent id in this Marrow account.

reference.description: Opaque identifier only; no URL, path, or raw evidence.

rationale.description: Optional concise rationale; redacted before transport.

type.description: Optional runtime action type. Defaults to coordination.

name: marrow_arbitrate
